qa_pairs.question: What does the left graph display concerning local disk usage?
qa_pairs.answer: The left graph illustrates the evolution of the number of input/output operations per second (IOPS) performed on the local disk over time.

qa_pairs.question: What information is presented in the right graph regarding local disk usage?
qa_pairs.answer: The right graph shows the evolution of the bandwidth used on the local disk over time, which represents the amount of data read or written per second.
